fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the organisation: made once from the name when the row is created, and kept when the name changes. It is a key, not a spelling.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the organisation is published under.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind of the organisation: `organisation` a company or another body, such as a university, a public body or a community group; `independent` a self-employed person or volunteer; `foundation` a foundation.

fields.name: github
fields.description: The login of the organisation's GitHub organisation, with the case it has on GitHub; empty when it has none. Commits in its repositories are evidence for an affiliation.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Other spellings of the name, separated by semicolons; free text, not keys.
